title: Review of c02 fch-chemoton c1 (SIBE): on fresh seed 5 the feed and catalyst dependence replicate (starved 323 vs fed 1984, no catalyst 9), but the catalyst sits on an open bilayer strip, not a vesicle, and forms no membrane layer; Weak
summary: I looked at the claim's pack/seed0 sheet, starve_fork.png and controls, then re-ran world.py, world_starve.py (feed cut at t=300) and world_noK.py with labkit on a new seed 5 (rerun*/), and totalled amphiphile and catalyst with the author's totals.py (totals_s5.json, totals_s5.png). From the noisy bath, bilayer worms, a few rings and one catalyst-bearing structure form by t~80. The catalyst-bearing body is an open, straight bilayer strip with K beaded along it (rerun/seed5/sheet.png t=81-600); it persists fed to t=600, but labkit finds K not membrane-like (aggregate rim/core 0.54, rim/outside 1.72) and only one K-free ring passes the u test. Total amphiphile falls 3642 -> 2308 (t=300) -> 1984 (t=600) instead of settling near 4000. Dependence replicates: with the feed cut at t=300 the K strip shrinks to one micelle and the total falls to 323 by t=600 (fed twin 1984, identical until t=300); with no catalyst 9 is left (181 by t=300).

observations.S: rerun/seed5/sheet.png t=0: unstructured noisy bath over the whole domain
observations.I: rerun/seed5/sheet.png t=81-600: a catalyst-bearing bilayer strip and a K-free ring persist as discrete bodies (6 components throughout)
observations.E: totals_s5.json: amphiphile at t=600 fed 1984 vs feed cut at t=300 323 (rerun_starve/seed5/sheet.png: the K strip shrinks to a single micelle by t~520); no catalyst 9

seeds_run.result: partial: E-type dependence replicates; the catalyst-bearing body is an open strip, not a vesicle, and K is not membrane-like (rim/core 0.54)

controls_run.E: rerun_starve/seed5 (feed cut at t=300) vs rerun/seed5 (fed twin, same seed)

verdicts.limitation: On the one fresh seed the claimed organization (vesicles carrying a catalyst layer on their bilayer) does not appear: the catalyst lives on an open strip, as on the author's seed 1, so the B part of the claim held on 2 of 4 seeds overall and same_individuals fails here. E holds by construction (amphiphile is made only by K from P and decays at kap). The fed total is still falling at t=600 on seed 5, so 'bounded size on the fed precursor' is not established for this seed. No resolution or dt test; one fresh seed only (each run takes about 6 minutes).
